What we build

Services

Exterior and interior improvements for cottages and homes — engineered for durability and finished with care.

Our specialty

Steel Roofing

A steel roof is the smartest long-term investment you can make in your home. Ours are built to shed Ontario snow, resist the elements and look sharp for decades — long after asphalt would need replacing. We handle standing-seam and metal roofing from tear-off to finishing, with clean detailing at every edge.

Note: We focus on premium steel roofing and do not install asphalt shingle roofs.

Get a roofing quote
Exterior

Siding

New siding is one of the fastest ways to transform your home's appearance while protecting it from moisture and weather. We install durable, great-looking siding with tight, consistent lines and proper detailing around every opening.

Talk siding options
Exterior

Soffit & Fascia

The finishing touches that make a roofline look complete — and keep your attic ventilated and dry. Clean, weather-tight soffit and fascia work protects against moisture, pests and rot while sharpening your home's overall look.

Ask about finishing work
Exterior & interior

Windows

Energy-efficient replacement windows bring in light, cut drafts and quiet the outside world — while adding real curb appeal. We handle careful removal, proper flashing and clean interior finishing so your new windows perform and look their best.

Plan a window upgrade
Outdoor living

Decks

Custom decks designed for lake views, entertaining and everyday enjoyment. We build solid, beautiful outdoor spaces tailored to your property and how you live. (We build decks — not docks.)

Design your deck
Bigger projects

Additions & Renovations

Need more space or a full transformation? We take on additions and interior and exterior renovations that add square footage, comfort and value. From concept through the final walkthrough, you get one accountable team focused on doing it right.

Who we are

About MarLane

A general contractor built on a simple promise: do quality work worth recommending.

Our story

Quality is the whole point

MarLane Contracting was built around one idea: the work should speak for itself. We're a general contractor serving cottages and homes across the Rideau Lakes region, specializing in exterior and interior improvements that add real, lasting value.

We focus on the projects where craftsmanship matters most — steel roofing, additions, decks, siding, soffit & fascia, and windows. These aren't jobs you want to redo. They're investments in your home, and we treat them that way, from the first walkthrough to the final detail.

Most of our business comes from referrals and repeat clients, and that's exactly how we like it. When you do quality work, you don't have to chase the next job — it comes to you.
